summary: The change stores URL.toString() for submitted callbacks, matching request-time normalization, and updates the regression test to round-trip a mixed-case host with an explicit default port through save and authorize.

evidence: src/passport.ts line 472 now pushes url.toString(), the same canonical serialization normalizeRedirectUri produces at request time.
src/handler_test.ts lines 2226-2227 and 2425-2430 save a callback with uppercase host and default HTTPS port and assert the stored response is the canonical form.
src/handler_test.ts line 2454 authorizes with the original non-canonical callback and expects success, demonstrating the save/authorize round trip.
